scope: Verify generated POINTCLOUDDEFINITIONEX/REACTOREX OBJECTS allocation rollback, same-adapter retry, and typed graph readback in ASCII and Binary DXF.

implementation.graph: A generated NOD soft-owner entry points to an ACAD_POINTCLOUD_EX_DICT. That dictionary's hard-owner entry targets POINTCLOUDDEFINITIONEX; the definition owns a POINTCLOUDDEFREACTOREX, and a POINTCLOUDEX entity references both records.
method: For each encoding, calibrate the number of allocations performed inside dx_iface::writeObjects using a high allocation countdown.
Inject std::bad_alloc at every calibrated offset. Require callback entry, exactly one injected failure, export refusal, and byte-for-byte preservation of a preexisting destination sentinel.

After each failure, disable injection and retry with the same dx_iface instance and dx_data. Import the result and verify the NOD/dictionary owner and key, definition/reactor records, and entity-to-definition/reactor references.
implementation.temporaryArtifacts: Generated ASCII/Binary DXFs are created under the system temporary directory and removed by the test.

limitations: This is generated local graph and transaction evidence for one POINTCLOUDEX profile; it does not establish physical producer coverage, point-cloud asset loading, or native consumer semantics.
Other OBJECTS builders, broader whole-drawing failure states, source lifetime, platform numeric/string policies, and general thread safety remain open.
Classic and Ex transaction controls are generated local graph evidence only; native point-cloud asset semantics and producer interoperability remain unqualified.
next: Continue the P6 OBJECTS safety audit on another independent uncovered builder; retain separate source-lifetime, platform numeric/string, scoped-concurrency, and broader whole-drawing failure gates.
supplementalScope: The same focused test now also sweeps every allocation in the classic POINTCLOUDDEFINITION/POINTCLOUDDEFREACTOR OBJECTS path in ASCII and Binary, with local source graph, destination rollback, caller graph preservation, same-adapter retry, and typed readback.

normalFocused.result: PASS 1/1; 1.30 seconds; includes EX and classic profiles in ASCII and Binary
